artworks.title: Sigismund III, King of Poland
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait engraving of a man in an elaborate outfit positioned centrally within an oval frame. The man has a mustache, a beard, and short hair, and is depicted facing forward with a composed expression. Two cherubs hold a ribbon with text below the portrait. The frame is surrounded by ornate architectural elements, including carvings and columns. An angelic figure with wings holds a scepter at the top of the frame. Classical statues are placed on either side of the portrait frame, along with engravings and inscriptions in the background.

artworks.title: Sigismund III, King of Poland and Sweden
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man from the chest up. He is positioned facing slightly to his left, with his gaze directed towards the viewer. The man has delicate facial features with a prominent mustache and a pointed beard. His hair is neatly combed back, revealing a high hairline. He is dressed in elaborate attire with a high, ornate ruff around his neck. His clothing is richly adorned with decorative patterns. The man wears several ornate pieces of ceremonial armor or regalia with detailed, intricate designs, and a sash or belt embellished with complex motifs. The background consists of a decorative oval frame with text, and there is a variety of scrollwork and coat-of-arms motifs along the edges. The bottom of the engraving contains additional text identifying the figure.

artworks.title: Sigismund III, King of Poland
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a man with distinctive facial features, including a mustache and a small pointed beard. He is wearing a tall, cylindrical hat with a large plumage, a ruffed collar, and richly patterned clothing. A sword hilt is visible in front of him. The background features an oval border with inscriptions, a crown above, and a heraldic eagle to the right.

artworks.title: Nicolas Brulart, Marquis de Sillery
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a man's body. He is seated or positioned facing the viewer with a dignified posture. The man has an aged face with distinct features such as pronounced wrinkles, a full white beard and mustache, and wavy white hair. He is wearing a high-collared garment under a fur-trimmed cloak or coat. There are no visible items in his hands. The background has a textured pattern with a rectangular tab in the top right corner, and the lower part of the image displays some Latin text.

artworks.title: Nicolas Brulart, Marquis de Sillery
artworks.description: The image shows a man's upper body, facing forward, with his chest, shoulders, and head visible. He has deep-set eyes, a prominent nose, and a full beard. His hair is wavy and framing his face. He is wearing a high-collared garment with fur trim, buttons, folds, and a decorative clasp at the neck. The background is a simple, textured monochrome. Below the man's image, there is text in a serifed font.

artworks.title: Josias Simler
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a man's upper body facing forward with his head slightly tilted to the left. He has a long, wavy beard and mustache, furrowed brow, and wears a hat with a narrow, curved brim. His attire includes a cloak or coat with a thick fur collar. The background consists of closely spaced horizontal lines, and there is Latin text below the portrait.

artworks.title: Sydrach Simpson, Preacher
artworks.description: The image shows a man in clerical attire from a three-quarter view. He has distinct facial features, including a mustache and goatee, curly hair partially covered by a cap, and is holding a small book. He is posed with his left hand on his chest and his right hand holding the book. The man wears a dark robe with a large white collar and cuffs typical of 17th-century clerical attire. In the background, there is a draped curtain on the left side. Below the portrait, there is text identifying the man as "Mr. Sydrach Simpson" with details about his roles and the book's printer.

artworks.title: William Slater, D.D.
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the chest upwards. The man is depicted facing forward but with his head slightly turned to the left. He has deep-set eyes, a pointed nose, a long beard, a mustache, and receding hair. He is wearing a dark garment with a white ruff collar. The background has a textured, cross-hatched pattern. An inscription below the portrait identifies the subject as "The true Portraiture of the Learned, Mr. William Slater D.D."

artworks.title: Hendrick Daniels Slatius, Preacher
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man from the chest up, positioned facing forward with a serious expression. He has a full beard and mustache, and short, slightly wavy hair parted to the side. He wears a high-collared garment with an elaborate ruff around his neck. The oval frame around him is intricately designed with scrollwork and two serpents. Also visible are a small image of a bearded face at the top and a depiction of an open book with the text "Liber Seditiosor" at the bottom. The background features parallel line shading typical of engraved portraits.

artworks.title: Henrich Daniel Slatius, Arminian Preacher
artworks.description: The image is a detailed portrait showing the head and upper torso of a bearded man. The man is facing forward with a direct gaze towards the viewer. He has short, wavy hair and a well-groomed beard and mustache. He wears a garment with a high, elaborate lace collar. Surrounding the portrait is an ornate oval frame with an inscription "Henricus Slationis Bleywickensis." In the background, there is an intricate design with two griffin-like creatures holding a banner, and an open book with the words "Liber Seditiosus" visible at the bottom of the frame. Text in decorative script appears beneath the frame.

artworks.title: Captain John Smith
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of Captain John Smith. He is shown from the chest up, facing slightly to his left but looking at the viewer. Smith has a long, wavy beard and mustache, with curly hair framing his face. He is wearing detailed armor and a ruffled collar typical of the period. There is text surrounding the oval portrait frame and additional text below the image. The background is plain, highlighting Smith's attire and the text.

artworks.title: Captain John Smith
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man's upper body. The man has a full beard and mustache, with medium length wavy hair. He is dressed in a detailed doublet with high collars and ornate embellishments. The man gazes directly ahead. The engraving is enclosed in an oval frame with accompanying text. Flanking the oval are vignettes of men in colonial attire and a globe. Beneath the man's image is a decorative inscription. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Sir Thomas Smith
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man sitting upright. He has a serious expression with distinct facial features, wearing a tall hat with a wide brim that conceals most of his hair. He is adorned with an intricate ruff collar around his neck and is dressed in a dark, fur-trimmed garment with detailed patterns. He holds a rolled paper or scroll in his hand. The background includes an oval frame with ornamental details, inscriptions, and a blank margin around the image. Below the portrait, there is an inscription and a coat of arms.

artworks.title: Louis de Bourbon, Conte de Soissons
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person in a three-quarter view. The individual appears youthful with full facial features, a curved nose, and curly hair framing the face. They wear a detailed historical European outfit consisting of a patterned doublet and a large lace collar. The person is not holding any objects or wearing visible jewelry. The background features a dark oval with lines extending outward and is bordered by text that reads "LOYS DE BOVRBON, COMTE DE SOISSONS." Below the portrait is a French text.

artworks.title: William Sommers, King Henry VIII's Jester
artworks.description: The engraving depicts a man standing with a confident posture. He is holding a horn, with his right hand at his waist. The man has a large nose, thin lips, and prominent eyes. He wears a feathered cap, a robe with a chain, a doublet with "H R" embroidered on it, puffed sleeves, and a bow-tied sash around his waist. The background shows a busy village scene with people interacting and buildings and trees.

artworks.title: Edward Seymour, First Duke of Somerset
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man's upper body. He is facing forward with a neutral expression, a long beard, and a mustache. He wears a hat with a feather plume and a decorative band. His attire includes a coat with a fur collar and a garment with a medallion on a chain. The background is detailed with crosshatching, and there is a circular frame with inscriptions surrounding the portrait. Latin text is displayed at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Edward Seymour, First Duke of Somerset
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man with a pointed nose, beard, mustache, deep-set eyes, and a furrowed brow. He wears a feathered hat, a stately garment with a fur collar, and an ornate medallion around his neck. The background features a circular architectural frame with text around it, and the portrait is done in an engraving style with detailed cross-hatching for a classical aesthetic.

artworks.title: Charles Seymour, Sixth Duke of Somerset
artworks.artist: John Smith after Jan van der Vaart
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a man known as The Duke of Somerset. He is portrayed in a three-quarter pose, looking directly at the viewer. He has a prominent nose, slightly arched eyebrows, and a calm expression. The man has curly, voluminous hair that falls to around shoulder length. He is wearing intricately detailed armor with visible rivets and a patterned lace cravat or necktie. The background is an oval shape in a neutral tone. The portrait is set against a plain backdrop, with a border surrounding the image. There is text below the portrait identifying the person and providing artist information.

artworks.title: Lady Frances Howard, Countess of Somerset
artworks.description: The portrait depicts a woman from the chest up. She has a composed expression, soft facial features, curly hair styled high with a decorative hairpiece and feather. She wear a detailed gown with lace and embroidery, a pleated ruff around her neck, and a cross pendant. The background is dark, emphasizing her attire and features. The image is framed with an oval border, with text detailing Lady Francis, Countess of Somerset.

artworks.title: Robert Carr, Earl of Somerset
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of Robert Car, Earl of Somerset. He is depicted from the chest up, facing slightly to his left. He has an oval face, large eyes, a distinct nose, and a neatly trimmed mustache and pointed goatee. His curly hair frames his face and extends to his shoulders. He is dressed in elaborate period clothing with intricate patterns, including a high lace collar, embroidery, and decorative sashes. There is a chain or badge across his chest. The background has detailed linework but is plain, with an oval border containing inscriptive details of his title.

artworks.title: The Portraitures of Robert, Earl of Somerset and Lady Frances Howard
artworks.description: The image shows the full bodies of two individuals, identified as Robert Earl of Somerset and Lady Frances Howard. They are standing side by side, facing forward. Robert Earl of Somerset has facial hair, wearing a round hat with feathers. He has curly hair, and is dressed in a decorated doublet, ruff collar, cape, hose, and shoes. Lady Frances Howard has curly hair, styled with a decorative headpiece. She wears a ruff collar, ornate gown with embroidery, structured shoulders, puffed sleeves, and jewelry. Both are on a checkered floor, with a heraldic crest in the upper right corner, in front of a plain background.

artworks.title: Earl and Countess of Somerset, Accomplices inthe Murder of Sir Thomas Overbury
artworks.description: The image is an illustration of the Earl and Countess of Somerset. The Earl is standing to the left, with one leg slightly forward and turned outward, while the Countess stands with hands on hips. The Earl has a bearded face, a ruffled collar, and is wearing a hat with a feather. He wears a cloak, a doublet, and short breeches. The Countess has an elaborate hairstyle and wears an ornate gown with a high collar and structured bodice. She is adorned with jewelry. The background is a simple, blank space with text beneath the image.

artworks.title: Sophia Hedwig, Duchess of Brunswick
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman from the waist up. She has a round face with high cheekbones and a slight smile. Her curly hair is styled with floral decorations or ribbons. She wears an ornate dress with lace detailing. In one hand, she holds a chain, and her other arm rests on a table. The background features a textured drapery.

artworks.title: Thomas Wriothesley, Earl of Southampton
artworks.description: The oval portrait depicts the upper half of a man's body. He is facing forward with his face slightly turned to the right, featuring long, slightly wavy hair that falls past his shoulders. The man has a neutral expression, a prominent nose, and rounded cheeks. He is dressed in 17th-century English fashion, wearing a dark robe with a white collar, without any visible jewelry or objects. The plain and dark background contrasts with the man's features and clothing. The portrait is framed by an off-white border with an inscription identifying him as Thomas Wriothesley, Earl of Southampton.
